To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the profit function of a two-unit system is a nondecreasing and concave function of the priority factor.
the profit of the system is a function of the system availability and the cost rate.
the profit of a two-unit system with random appearance-disappearance of the operator is a function of the system parameters and the cost parameters of the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) the determination of the steady-state probabilities of the states of the system at the regenerative epochs, (2) the determination of various measures of system effectiveness such as the expected number of units on, the expected number of failed units, the expected number in repair, and the expected number of failures of the system per unit time, (3) the determination of optimal number of units and the optimal repair rate of each unit to minimize the total expected cost per unit time, and
the study of a system consisting of two units, one priority and one ordinary, in a cold standby configuration.

the following problems: (a) to determine the probability that the system is in the N-state, (b) to determine the expected profit rate of the system, (c) to determine the optimal value of the unit’s repair cost, (d) to find the optimal number of the ordinary units, and (e) to obtain the optimal value of a certain parameter of the model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system is more effective in the case of the priority unit than that of the ordinary one.
the model is a very useful tool to study the system effectiveness in a two-unit system with a random appearance and disappearance operator.
the system is more profitable when the unit is operated at a lower rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed model is useful in the analysis of a two- unit system with random appearance-disappearance of the operator.
the system effectiveness measures are obtained in terms of various system parameters and the system performance is analyzed in the context of the system effectiveness measures.
we have developed a general model of a man-machine system with two units, and have derived a number of performance measures.

the expected profit per unit time of the system can be increased by increasing the number of ordinary units.
